pairs.subject: modal-stack
pairs.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 hard-deletes a template with no confirm or undo and closes at :311 before the await settles, so failure is only logged (cards/useGalleryActions.ts:208); 5 of 5 judged techniques fail (anchored-positioning left unjudged)

techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 hard-deletes a template with no confirm or undo and closes at :311 before the await settles, so a failed delete is only logged (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/useGalleryActions.ts:208) - confirm-then-fail with no confirm

src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/useModalStack.ts:24 is a second, feature-private stack beside the app registry (src/lib/ui/ModalStackContext.tsx), addressed by kind not identity (close(type) at :37), and CompareModal bypasses it on a local boolean (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/GeneratedReviewsTab.tsx:353 isOpen={compareOpen})

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:283 backdrop click calls onClose unguarded on every modal, incl. CatalogCredentialModal whose typed credential fields (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:113) vanish on a stray click; one onClose callback cannot tell cancel from dismiss

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:230 restores focus only on the isOpen flag-flip, but RebuildModal and CatalogCredentialModal close by unmount (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:62) so focus drops to the document root; BaseModal has no scroll lock or background inertness

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:9 portal modals sit at hand-picked z 10000 while the shared Tooltip portals to body at z-[9999] (src/features/shared/components/display/Tooltip.tsx:348), so CompareModal tooltips (CompareModal.tsx:223) render beneath their own modal
src/features/shared/components/display/Tooltip.tsx:338 the only anchored surface here is the shared Tooltip primitive, owned by context display-data-formatters; not judged from this consumer

pairs.registryProposal: Coverage hole in the consumer context map, not the corpus: src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx and src/lib/ui/ModalStackContext.tsx - the app-wide overlay primitives that realize (or fail) most modal-stack techniques - belong to no context in context-map.json, so modal-stack governs only this gallery consumer and the primitive defects (no scroll lock, flag-only focus restore, z 10000 vs Tooltip z-9999) are judged secondhand. A context for src/lib/ui overlay primitives, paired with modal-stack, would let the fix land once.
